comparison.objective: Invert a cake pan and plate together, set them down, and lift the pan away to release the cake.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual clamping, coordinated 180-degree inversion, compliant release, and un-molding versus repeated sifting motions.
comparison.success_condition: Cake upside down and centered on plate/stand, pan removed, all still 2 s; damage/drop conditions apply in full rubric.
comparison.reason: Both manage contents during orientation change, but this tests whole-item inversion and mold release, not size-selective many-body passage.
